biography: Ricke has carved out a distinct, albeit concise, presence within the esteemed Hector Trophée. Over the course of the tournament's history, he has participated in two editions, a testament to his engagement with this unique pair competition.

During his two participations, Ricke consistently exhibited a tenacious spirit on the course. Although the ultimate triumphs of the Hector Trophée or the individual Victor Trophy eluded him, his game was characterized by a diligent effort and a visible passion for competition.

For the upcoming Hector Trophée 2026, Ricke will not be competing, as his engagement with competitive Hector events is understood to have concluded. His past two appearances, while brief, represent a chapter in the tournament's history, highlighting a competitor whose commitment, though not leading to silverware, was evident to all.
